execution_policy.local_execution: metadata inspection and tiny deterministic unit fixtures only
execution_policy.api_generation: separate explicit opt-in with capped calls; preparation never calls a model

shared_response_configuration.system_prompt_rule: One identical prompt, recorded with its hash before generation, for all arms
shared_response_configuration.alias_policy: Freeze before generation; reject missing, unapproved or inconsistent reported model names

memory_boundary.confirmation_policy: Never invent user consent or promote benchmark candidates to confirmed user facts
memory_boundary.gold_policy: Reference answers, category/evidence labels and answerability are scoring-only; never candidate-generation inputs
memory_boundary.scope_policy: One LoCoMo conversation or LongMemEval question per retrieval scope; statistical clusters never pool retrieval

success_rules.directional_improvement: Paired cluster confidence-interval lower bound must exceed zero, with precision and all other gates satisfied
success_rules.at_least_meaningful_effect: Paired cluster confidence-interval lower bound must reach the predeclared minimum_effect; a point estimate alone is insufficient

precision_plan.failure_interpretation: If final precision target is missed, report inconclusive; do not add convenient cases after seeing results

statistics.sample_size_claim: 500 questions do not guarantee adequate power or precision; actual independent groups and final uncertainty must be reported
statistics.secondary_inference: descriptive unless a separate multiplicity-controlled hypothesis was frozen beforehand

completion_and_failure_policy.identity_or_integrity_failure: abort and invalidate formal scoring; never silently retry with another model
completion_and_failure_policy.partial_cohort: progress report only, never the formal endpoint
completion_and_failure_policy.budget: Freeze call and retry budget before API opt-in; failed calls may also incur charges

judge.same_family_bias: Response and judge share a model family; disclose this limitation

locomo10.category_5_policy: Excluded from ordinary answer correctness; adversarial_answer is a distractor, never a gold answer

longmemeval_s_cleaned.evaluator: Exact pinned upstream per-type reference prompts; DeepSeek adaptation with strict yes/no parsing, not the paper official model score

development_exposure.exposure_definition: Question/answer/history inspection for model or prompt development; checksum/schema-only validation is not performance tuning
development_exposure.interpretation: Removing only the 20 QA is insufficient: nine conversations have development exposure. The full LoCoMo result remains exploratory.

longmemeval_s_cleaned.metadata_verification: Official immutable-revision API LFS oid/size; full file intentionally not downloaded to the local machine

development_exposure.interpretation: Audit all prior LongMemEval question/history use before declaring this an independent locked test; oracle and S can share question identities.
